idea-plugin.name: WindowBuilder Classic
idea-plugin.description:
A visual designer for Java Swing that works directly on plain Java code – modelled on the Eclipse WindowBuilder. There are no .form files and no generated sections: the designer reads the Java source, shows the window and writes every change back as ordinary code you can keep editing by hand.
  • A Design tab next to the source of every Swing class (JFrame, JPanel, JDialog, JInternalFrame and classes that create a window, such as an "Application Window")
  • Palette, component tree and property table
  • Two-way editing: changes in the source show up in the designer, changes in the designer become Java code in the WindowBuilder style
  • Absolute layout with snapping and alignment tools, BorderLayout, FlowLayout, GridLayout, GridBagLayout (column and row headers, WindowBuilder-style constraints and gaps), CardLayout, BoxLayout, SpringLayout and GroupLayout (NetBeans forms open, too); MigLayout and FormLayout when the library is on the classpath
  • JScrollPane, JSplitPane, JTabbedPane, menus and popup menus, struts & springs, AWT components
  • Event handlers, multiple selection, cut/copy/paste, convert local ↔ field, externalize strings
  • Custom components are rendered by running the compiled project code (can be switched off)
  • Wizards for JFrame, JPanel, JDialog, JInternalFrame and Application Window
